problem: Card moves can succeed without a user-visible confirmation step, leaving the user unsure what happened.

post_action: After moving a card, verify the board projection shows the card under the target list.
Then offer the user the expected next step, such as returning to the board, showing the target list, or summarizing what changed.

rationale: This improves user experience by pairing verified state with a helpful follow-up suggestion, reducing back-and-forth.
verification: Use the preferred board projection or visible-cards-by-list read to confirm the new list membership.
Do not claim success until verification passes.
